I am too old to be carrying heavy bags of fertilizer from the shop, and those government coupons are for maize farmers anyway. I have three goats and a few chickens, so I will spread their manure on the field before planting. I keep my own sorghum seed from last year — it has always done well here in Nsanje even when the rains are poor and the low areas flood. I do not use those chemical sprays; they cost too much and sorghum does not need them. I will wait for the rains like always. My wife and I will work the field together, and my grandson will help when he is not at the market.
